product_title: Elegant Floral Toran with Golden Details & Pearl Tassels (38 inches)
product_description: Enhance your home entrance with this elegant handcrafted toran, featuring beautiful ivory floral motifs, vibrant pink roses, intricate golden detailing, and graceful pearl tassels. Perfect for Diwali, weddings, pooja rooms, and traditional festive décor.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth.
Avoid water, moisture, and harsh chemicals.
Handle flowers and pearl tassels with care.
Store flat in a cool, dry place after use.
